title: Flow Language Vertical Slice
description: End-to-end vertical slice for flow procedural language: neural engine (Dictionary/Neuron/Evaluator), math module, DAG UI crate, flow core wasm, react renderer, and play app with slider->add->preview default fixture.
summary: Aligned flow play catalogue drag-and-drop with puzzle 2d/3d: workbench tree rows carry flow widget palette MIME + TreeDragAndDropController; FlowCanvas accepts pointer-palette and HTML5 drops via fixtureDragDrop. Fixed FlowPlayKindsPanel to use flowWidgetPaletteTreeDragController (platform uiTreeNodeToTreePanelConfig only knew puzzle MIME). Updated validate-flow-runtime.mjs for workbench radio toggle and pointer-palette mouse drag. Validation passes on :6016.
